Minimal preset preserves nav, footer, aside

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, PreprocessingOptions, PreprocessingPreset

def main() -> None:
    html = "<nav>Navigation</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer>"
    options = ConversionOptions(preprocessing=PreprocessingOptions(preset=PreprocessingPreset("Minimal")))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
